name: Extra Old White Cheddar
description: President's Choice Extra Old White Cheddar. Listed package: 400 g. Retailer overview: “Extra old white cheddar is firm and slightly crumbly in texture. It is both earthy and sharp in its rich flavour as the most aged.”
